title: AirstrikePointers
description: This mod adds a laser pointer to Minecraft that allows players to mark targets and guide projectiles
body:
This mod adds two tools for creating target designations in the world: the **Laser Pointer** and the **Pocket Laser Pointer**.

![Using a pointer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37c992714fd7aa2ccd7b4b2fa7af70c9ca5275c0_0.webp)

---

## Laser Pointer

The main tool, offering functionality similar to a telescope. Players can aim at blocks or entities to place visible markers to share with other players or to guide fire.

### Usage

-   **Hold Right Click** to enter the pointer interface, **release** to mark the target.
-   **Shift + Right Click** switches between operation modes.
-   **Shift + Left Click** clears all markers created by you.

![Aiming](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e00e50a21f44aae8fd09d11530a9c4833a4429f_0.webp)

### Marker Modes

The Laser Pointer has two modes: **Point Marker** and **Vector Marker**.

**Point Marker Mode**

The marker attaches to the targeted block or entity. The marker's name is displayed below, and the name of the targeted entity is displayed above (if attached to an entity).

![Pointed a block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8958fdbdf191b54cd47b5d8688116f174a5e70b4_0.webp)
![Pointed an entity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/284fbde4efbd1d690a87fba4d2247cb99d20f07d_0.webp)

If guidance is enabled, the Point Marker will guide configured entities toward the marker by altering their velocity direction.

![Guidance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1c16cb13387a96ccadcbad9746ca2ee5e41e1c1f_0.webp)

If the marked entity dies, despawns, or is unloaded, the entity name will display an additional "X" prefix/suffix, and guidance will cease.

![The X prefix/suffix](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dc9bf6b742316a3ac1ed00b32ff3d80b49a41a0_0.webp)

**Vector Marker Mode**

Vector Markers create prominent directional indicators by selecting a start point and an end point. They indicate the path from start to end, making them ideal for guiding airstrikes.

![Vector marker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a6e72ac22d00fd9cc83fdda47260c63a44b200d_0.webp)

However, Vector Mode has slightly lower rendering compatibility and may have rendering issues in some situations (e.g., when shaders are enabled).

![Vector marker render bugs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e3670d60414a337e08bb983f0aa5d2aa98e291d_0.webp)

---

## Pocket Laser Pointer

A companion tool designed for quick, non-guided marking. Unlike the Laser Pointer, markers from the Pocket Laser Pointer **cannot be guided** — perfect for temporary callouts and communication.

![A pocket pointer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7911ae83a791fa136be18566528ea56c39aff66c.png)

### Controls

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Right Click (short) | Auto-mark with smart icon |
| Hold Right Click | Open icon wheel → select → release |
| Sneak + Right Click | Clear all your markers |

### Fast Mark (Short Press)

A quick right-click marks the target immediately with an auto-selected icon based on context:

| Target | Condition | Icon |
|---|---|---|
| Hostile Entity | Max HP ≥ 100 (boss) | Danger |
| Hostile Entity | Normal | Caution |
| Player | — | Like |
| Friendly Mob | — | Defend |
| Block | Player HP < 50% & ≤ 2m away | Danger |
| Block | Has loot/chest/barrel inventory | Satisfied |
| Default | — | Dot |

![Fast Mark](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab752f2697d37560d74bb87c9fe994f8482e8bf1.png)

### Wheel Mark (Long Press)

Hold right-click for ~3 ticks (configurable on client) to open a radial selection wheel with 8 icons. Drag your mouse toward an icon and release to place the marker with your chosen icon.

-   The wheel origin is captured at the moment you press right-click — you can pre-drag during the hold window and release instantly when the wheel appears.
-   A lever click sound plays when the wheel opens, and a note block beep plays on successful mark.

![Wheel opened](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2733500877d92b9264a526715fc654bda1cca6f9.png)

### Key Differences from Laser Pointer

-   Markers cannot be guided
-   No spyglass zoom overlay
-   One marker per player at a time
-   Auto icon selection based on target context
-   Client-configurable wheel activation delay

---

## General Features

Features shared by both tools:

-   **Team Colors:** When a player is in a team, the marker automatically uses the team's color. Markers created by players not in a team use a color determined by their UUID.

![Team colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04513acd8f7cb9336fd337d8cad1176f6df29022.png)

-   **Custom Naming:** If the pointer is named on an anvil, the created marker will additionally display the pointer's name.

![Renaming with an anvil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83e3a020fb400c0989cb0efcecdd818a84a17e97.png)
![Additional subtitle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e0a3e3b3bbebfb07390f04882dd5f7717f90aa6_0.webp)

-   **Synchronization & Config:** Markers are fully synchronized in multiplayer. Duration and usage cooldown times are configurable on the server side. Expired markers are automatically cleaned up.
-   **Client Settings:** The client can configure whether to only show markers from their own team and the maximum distance for displaying markers.
-   **Hot-reload:** Configuration supports `/reload`.
-   **Marker Size & Visibility:** Markers beyond 1000 meters will be less visible.

---

## Known Rendering Issues (Vector Markers)

-   Certain shader packs may cause markers to be invisible or change color.
-   Clouds can occlude marker rendering; if you frequently need to spot markers from above the clouds, it is recommended to disable clouds.
-   Water surfaces may cause markers to change color.
-   At specific distances, Distant Horizons LOD models may occlude markers.
